science.qualification: Uniform photosphere color from the star's measured spectrum (Burnashev (1985), Abastumani Astrophys. Obs. Bull. 59, 83; VizieR III/126, part2 record 75 (BS 2040), cross-checked against Gaia DR3 XP spectrum, source 2887731882922767744 (78 levels apart at most, the threshold is 12)). No limb darkening is drawn: no mass is measured and no spectroscopic surface gravity is published with this radius: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770 assume the gravity of their fit (table column 15). The disc is unresolved: no map or absolute brightness is implied. Self-luminous, so no lighting.
